note: Machine half of references/compliance.md (same ids). Regexes are case-insensitive and run on NFKC-normalized text.

rules.title: Payment amount is a Reg Z trigger term
rules.message: Stating a payment amount requires the down payment, the repayment terms and the APR in the same post. Usual fix: drop the payment amount. Otherwise add your compliance-approved APR example (apr_disclosure).

rules.title: Down payment amount or percent is a Reg Z trigger term
rules.message: A down payment amount or percentage (including 0% or no money down) requires the repayment terms and the APR in the same post. Usual fix: say 'low down payment options' with no number, or add the approved APR example.

rules.title: Number of payments or loan term offered with credit
rules.message: Offering a specific term or number of payments is a trigger term. Reporting a survey average for the 30-year fixed is market news; offering one is advertising credit.

rules.title: A rate offered by you must be stated as an APR
if_any: \b(as low as|starting at|rates? from|our rates?|my rates?|we can (get|offer)|lock (in )?(at|your rate at)?|get you)\b[^.\n]{0,30}\d+(\.\d+)?\s?%
rules.message: If the post states a rate you offer, it must state it as an annual percentage rate (APR), with the other terms the trigger rules require. Without an approved example, do not state your own rate: point to a quote instead.

rules.title: A survey rate needs its source and a not-an-offer line
rules.append: Rates shown are Freddie Mac PMMS weekly national averages, not a quote or an offer of credit. Your own rate depends on your situation.
rules.message: Market rates quoted from a survey are averages, not what you offer. Name the source and say it is not an offer, so the post cannot be read as a rate advertisement.
rules.source: Regulation Z, 12 CFR 1026.24(c); Reg N (MAP Rule), 12 CFR 1014.3(e)

rules.title: Loan officer and company NMLS ID
rules.message: State rules require the originator's name and NMLS ID (and usually the company's) on advertising, including social media. Maryland accepts the ID on the profile instead; this bundle adds it to every post.
rules.source: SAFE Act state rules; Texas SML RMLO social media requirements (2025); COMAR 09.03.06.06

rules.title: Equal Housing Opportunity or Lender statement
rules.message: Mortgage ads carry the Equal Housing statement your company uses. It is a legal requirement for some lenders (FDIC-supervised banks: 'Equal Housing Lender') and a policy of most others; this bundle adds it to every post as a conservative default. Remove it only on your compliance team's written say-so.
rules.source: 12 CFR 338.3 (FDIC-supervised lenders); HUD Equal Housing Opportunity logo guidance; lender and investor policy (not verified as a federal rule for every originator)

rules.title: Guaranteed approval or 'everyone qualifies'
rules.message: Approval depends on underwriting. Promising it misrepresents the terms of credit. Say what you will do instead (review options, explain programs).
rules.source: Reg N (MAP Rule), 12 CFR 1014.3; FTC Act §5

rules.title: Possible implied government affiliation
rules.message: FHA, VA and USDA loans are government-insured or guaranteed, but you are not the government. Do not suggest an official program, a government grant for all, or an endorsement.

rules.title: Rate forecast stated as a fact
if_any: \brates (will|are going to|are about to) (drop|fall|go down|rise|go up|spike|crash)\b
rules.message: Nobody knows next week's rate. Say what happened (the survey), not what will happen, or attribute a forecast to its source.
rules.source: Reg N (MAP Rule), 12 CFR 1014.3(e); FTC Act §5

rules.title: 'Fixed' next to an adjustable product
rules.message: An adjustable-rate product is fixed only for its initial period. Say how long, and that it adjusts after.

rules.title: Realtor co-marketing that may look like a referral payment
if_any: \b(referral fee|paid partner|pay for referrals|kickback|split the cost of (the )?ad)\b
rules.message: Co-marketing is fine when each party pays its share at fair value. Anything that reads as paying or being paid for referrals is a RESPA Section 8 risk; check with your compliance team.
rules.source: RESPA §8, 12 U.S.C. 2607; Regulation X, 12 CFR 1024.14; CFPB Compliance Bulletin 2015-05

rules.title: Wording that may target or exclude a protected class
rules.message: Fair lending and fair housing rules bar ads that indicate a preference based on familial status, age-linked proxies, religion, national origin, race, sex or disability. Describe the loan, not the borrower.
rules.source: Equal Credit Opportunity Act / Regulation B, 12 CFR 1002.4(b); Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(c)

rules.title: Superlative no one can verify
rules.message: 'Lowest rates in town' needs proof the post shows. Use a specific, sourced fact from facts.md instead.
rules.source: FTC Act §5; Reg N (MAP Rule), 12 CFR 1014.3
